_README: One object per meeting. Newest can go anywhere — the site sorts by date. Fields: id (unique, no spaces), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD or full ISO), tags (list), description (one line), coverImage (optional, e.g. 'assets/slides/java-basics.webp'), slidesUrl (paste the Google Slides/PDF link AFTER the meeting; leave '' until then), availableFrom (optional ISO datetime — defaults to the meeting date at MEETING.endTime24 in config.js). Entries with "placeholder": true are SAMPLE cards — delete them once you add real meetings. A slidesUrl of '#demo' is a sample link.
